test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Six letters J, K, L, M, N and O are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure below. Find the letter on the face opposite to J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad032656c76ec193d3241441877f9e12abc248003f07b203cb26f4ece1abb8d0.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As O is common on both the dices, it is clear that M, N, K, and J are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. L will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92e4ba0f61f5057d30040eeb282f4a27f05585b36c40f5b80bbf7035f629f41a.png] 

Opposite pairs:

N → J

M → K

O → L

So, the opposite side of "J" will be side "N".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
